label: Te Kāhui Manu Hōkai incorporated society dissolved
summary: The incorporated society Te Kahui Manu Hokai - Maori GIS Association Incorporated was dissolved. The name appeared in later Māori GIS conferences and mapping activities; these do not establish continued incorporation.
